title: 第二十五章 白袖夜祭第二十六章 亡魂不是阵料
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
lines: 白火从乱葬沟深处亮起。
普通火烧木头，烧纸钱，烧尸骨。白火烧的是魂名。它一起，沟里那些倒插的骨牌就开始发抖，像有无数小手在泥里拼命往外抓。
阿泥在安魂纸里哭起来。
沈清萝把安魂纸压在引魂铃旁边。
她说完就知道这话没用。
她转身就往白火方向走。
谢无咎伸手扣住她腕骨。
“跟你学的。你之前不也替我安排过别乱下井吗？”
阿青小声：“这时候翻旧账，不太合适吧？”
燕不归已经带人从另一侧包过去。
话音刚落，白火中央立起一个纸人。
纸人穿白袖，脸上没有五官，袖口却绣着和方怀仁一样的暗纹。旁边还有三个低阶邪修，眼睛发直，明显被控了神智。
沈清萝把桃木剑往地上一点。
纸傀袖口一抬，七块被烧名的骨牌同时亮起。
阿满发出一声闷哼，半边魂影被白火扯得发虚。
谢无咎抬手，煞气要碎纸傀。
燕不归从另一边压住一名邪修，冷声道：“十息。”
content_en:
White fire lit up from the depths of the mass grave.
Not an ordinary fire.
Ordinary fires burn wood, paper money, and bones. The white fire burns the name of the soul. As soon as it came together, the dominoes inserted upside down in the ditch began to tremble, like countless small hands trying to claw out in the mud.
Ah Ni cried in the requiem paper.
"It hurts."
Shen Qingluo pressed the requiem paper next to the soul-inducing bell.
"Bear with me."
After she said it, she knew it was useless.
She turned around and walked towards Bai Huo.
Xie Wujiu reached out and clasped her wrist.
"The formation is not yet stable."
"So be quick."
"You go over now, Aman will disperse."
"Then you watch."
Xie Wujiu's eyes turned cold.
"You can arrange it."
"Learned from you. Didn't you also arrange for me not to go down the well randomly?"
Ah Qing whispered: "Isn't it appropriate to settle old scores at this time?"
Shen Qingluo: "Appropriate. People are sober."
Yan Bugui had already led someone to wrap him up from the other side.
"I'll catch them alive."
Xie Wujiu said: "It's just a paper puppet."
As soon as he finished speaking, a paper man stood up in the center of the white fire.
The paper man wears white sleeves and has no facial features, but the cuffs are embroidered with the same dark patterns as Fang Huairen. There were three low-level evil cultivators beside them. Their eyes were straight, and they were obviously mentally disturbed.
The paper puppet spoke in a high-pitched voice.
"Shen Qingluo, you shouldn't save him."
Shen Qingluo lowered the peach wood sword to the ground.
"Whoever I save is not the Paper Man Cult's turn."
The paper puppet raised its sleeves, and the seven dominoes whose names were burned lit up at the same time.
Aman let out a muffled groan, and half of his soul was weakened by the white fire.
Xie Wujiu raised his hand and wanted to shred the paper puppet into pieces.
Shen Qingluo immediately shouted: "Don't break it!"
Xie Wujiu stopped reluctantly.
"What to do with it?"
"It still has a score in its mouth."
"You also want to check the paper man's account?"
"Everyone who can talk owes me an explanation!"
Yan Bugui suppressed an evil cultivator from the other side and said coldly: "Ten breaths."
